mapper.sql: goods_id, `day`, retail_price, cost, margin_pct, stock_total, available, views, sales_qty, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into litemall_product_metric_daily (goods_id, `day`, retail_price, cost, margin_pct, stock_total, available, views, sales_qty, update_time) values (#{goodsId}, #{day}, #{retailPrice}, #{cost}, #{marginPct}, #{stockTotal}, coalesce(#{available}, 1), coalesce(#{views}, 0), coalesce(#{salesQty}, 0), now()) on duplicate key update retail_price = values(retail_price), cost = values(cost), margin_pct = values(margin_pct), stock_total = values(stock_total), available = values(available), views = values(views), sales_qty = values(sales_qty), update_time = now()

insert into litemall_product_metric_daily (goods_id, `day`, available, update_time) values (#{goodsId}, #{day}, #{available}, now()) on duplicate key update available = values(available), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select from litemall_product_metric_daily where goods_id = #{goodsId} and `day` >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) order by `day` asc
